# Afthar N N

> Full stack developer in Kerala, India. I build websites, web apps, automations, voice agents and CRM tools for people who need software that works every day.

## What I do

- Websites and web apps built from scratch, with server rendering and on page SEO
- Internal tools: HRMS, admin panels, role based access, reporting
- Custom CRM and pipeline tools for small teams
- Business automations with n8n and Make: lead capture, routing, follow ups, reporting
- Realtime AI voice agents
- Booking flows, payments and CMS handover

## Stack

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Redis, Docker, Vercel, Render.

## Experience

- Full Stack Developer at 8 Chili, Bangalore, June 2026 to now. Internal project management and HRMS platform.
- Full Stack Developer, freelance, at MAS Design and Code, November 2025 to May 2026. Role based HRMS, company site, form automations.
- Frontend Developer Intern at Talks and Talks, February 2025 to August 2025. React interfaces, cut initial load by about 30 percent.

## Education
